description: Achievable Rate Analysis for Massive MIMO Base Stations with One-Bit ADCs is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Linköpings universitet. MATLAB files for the computation of numerical achievable rates of the uplink of a massive MIMO system, where the base station quantizes the received signals with one-bit ADCs. The dataset was originally published in DiVA and moved to SND in 2024. Coverage: Linköpings universitet. The publisher named on the listing is Linköpings universitet. Its keywords include system, kommunikation, systems, communication. The listing shows 2024-06-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
